correctness.rationale: The nonnegative population simplex is invariant, I_D>=I0 exp(-gamma T) on finite intervals, and b=w/sqrt(D) obeys a Riccati equation with uniform upper and lower comparison bounds after t~D^-1/2. This forces S_D->0 at each positive time. Exact convolution I=K exp(-gamma t)-S+gamma integral exp[-gamma(t-u)]S(u)du gives I_D->K exp(-gamma t). Uniform compact-time convergence away from zero and scalar moving barriers yield b->sqrt(beta1/I), while bounded convergence of bI in the log S equation yields the claimed exponent. On tau=sqrt(D)t, continuous dependence gives the 3D nonlinear initial layer, converging to S=0,I=K,b=sqrt(beta1/K). Strict positivity and finite-time boundedness assumptions are essential; the proof is specific to ODE, not PDE.
